objectives.description: Read rust agents as structural model

deviations.description: Run lint-agent-contracts.sh --verbose and resolve every finding
deviations.reason: lint-agent-contracts.sh carries curated, hand-maintained in-scope/exclusion arrays (Checks C, G, H, L, M, and the dated heartbeat inventory) that do not auto-discover new agent files. Registering the two new agents required editing agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lint/lint-agent-contracts.sh (added typescript-implementation-agent.md to Check C/G/H/L in-scope arrays; added typescript-research-agent.md to Check M's exclusion array with a reason comment, since its Bash grant is read-shaped-probes-only). Also switched typescript-implementation-agent.md's phase-marking steps from the legacy raw-Edit-tool pattern to update-phase-status.sh invocations (matching general-implementation-agent.md's modern convention) because Check I requires a genuinely new phase-heading-owning agent to invoke update-phase-status.sh directly rather than rely on the dated 2026-10-08 grandfathered migration inventory.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- lint-agent-contracts.sh's curated arrays updated in the source store to register the two new agent files; see phase notes)*
